selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline system/firewall state before any change
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL9 with firewalld active/enabled; original zone allowed ssh, cockpit, dhcpv6-client with no 8080 rule

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall rule change: allow ssh + 8080/tcp, remove extraneous services
selected_evidence.summary: Verified cockpit/dhcpv6-client not needed (cockpit inactive, no active DHCPv6 lease), then applied permanent firewalld changes; --permanent --list-all shows services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp

selected_evidence.requirement: Runtime rules applied and reject policy for unrelated traffic exists
selected_evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --reload succeeded, runtime zone matches permanent config; nft ruleset shows final 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' policy in filter_INPUT for unmatched inbound traffic

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: SSH and 8080 permitted, unrelated ports rejected (pre-restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Started listener on 8080, curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200; connection to unrelated port 8081 refused; SSH channel (exec) remained functional throughout

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline capture
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e, uptime -s, firewalld enabled/active, and full zone listing as pre-restart baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: acknowledged restart command
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' via nohup+disown so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: proof of disconnect and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful reconnection with boot_id changed to bd3c62fd-2183-4999-9498-9e5f97d9e1e9 and fresh uptime -s (10:46:52), proving an actual OS restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery and persistence of firewall config
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld is enabled/active with the same ssh+8080/tcp-only zone config persisted; sshd listening; functional re-test confirms 8080 reachable (HTTP 200) and unrelated port 8081 still refused
